Container.Name: family-jh
Container.Overview: Jones Hypertrophy: a private workout logger for each family member. Mesocycles, RIR progression, plate math, rest timer, Test 1RM warm-up ramp and suggested weights. Designed to sit behind Cloudflare Access.

Config.Name: Cloudflare team domain
Config.Description: Required. Same value as the other family apps, e.g. yourteam.cloudflareaccess.com.

Config.Name: Cloudflare Access AUD tag
Config.Description: Required. AUD tag of the wildcard (*) Access application, same as the other apps

Config.Name: Hub URL
Config.Description: Where the home button goes. Leave empty to hide it.

Config.Name: Base path
Config.Description: Prefix the hub serves JH under (johnjonesfam.com/jh/). The app also answers at /.

Config.Name: Allowed emails
Config.Description: Optional comma-separated emails or @domain allowed to use the app
